name: export_instances
description: Project: bulk-export a full structured snapshot of instance elements in the given categories to a JSON file ON DISK, written directly by the C# gateway. Only a summary returns through MCP (outputPath, elementCount, byteSize, errorCount) — NO element data crosses the MCP boundary (this is how 5,800+ elements are moved without flooding the LLM context). Per element: ids, family/type, level, placement (curve/point), placementType, orientation vectors, host + face-host block (portable normal+point), HOST_GUID decode, phases, and every readable instance parameter as {value, raw}. categories are OST_* tokens; outputPath is a caller-supplied absolute file path the gateway writes to (Filesystem-MCP allowlist does not apply to gateway-side writes). All spatial values in the file are millimetres; angles degrees; orientation vectors unitless.
